content.value_statement: Vector search projects need clear architecture choices before teams commit to an index or database. This skill guides retrieval design, embedding strategy, and tuning for production systems.
actual_capabilities: Compares vector database options such as Pinecone, Weaviate, Qdrant, Milvus, and pgvector.
Recommends embedding models, dimensions, chunking, and overlap strategies for retrieval workloads.
Plans index configuration for HNSW, IVF, and product quantization tradeoffs.
Designs metadata filtering, pre-filtering, and post-filtering patterns for search quality.
Guides hybrid search designs that combine vector and keyword retrieval.
Identifies latency, recall, caching, monitoring, and reindexing considerations.
limitations: It provides guidance and plans, not a managed vector database service.
It does not benchmark your data unless you provide measurements and workload details.
It cannot guarantee recall, latency, or cost without production traffic testing.
It references an optional playbook path that is not present in this package.

use_cases.title: Plan a RAG Retrieval Layer
use_cases.description: Design a document retrieval system with chunking, embeddings, metadata filters, and index choices.

use_cases.title: Tune Search Infrastructure
use_cases.description: Evaluate latency, recall, caching, and reindexing plans for high volume vector workloads.

use_cases.title: Select a Vector Database
use_cases.description: Compare database options against scale, hosting, filtering, hybrid search, and team operations needs.

prompt_templates.title: Choose a Database
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner planning a first vector search project.
prompt_templates.prompt: Help me choose a vector database for my project. Ask for missing requirements, then compare Pinecone, Weaviate, Qdrant, Milvus, and pgvector.

prompt_templates.title: Design Document Retrieval
prompt_templates.scenario: Team building semantic search over documents.
prompt_templates.prompt: Design a semantic search workflow for my documents. Include chunking, embedding model selection, metadata fields, indexing, and validation steps.

prompt_templates.title: Add Hybrid Search
prompt_templates.scenario: Existing search system needs better keyword and semantic matching.
prompt_templates.prompt: Review my retrieval requirements and propose a hybrid search design. Include ranking, filters, query flow, and evaluation metrics.

prompt_templates.title: Optimize Production Retrieval
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced team improving scale and quality.
prompt_templates.prompt: Analyze my vector search architecture for latency, recall, cost, monitoring, caching, and reindexing risks. Give a prioritized improvement plan.

output_examples.input: I need semantic search for 200,000 support articles.
output_examples.output: A retrieval plan covering chunk size, overlap, metadata fields, candidate databases, index type, validation metrics, and launch checks.

output_examples.input: Our RAG system misses exact product names and part numbers.
output_examples.output: A hybrid search recommendation with keyword matching, vector retrieval, result fusion, metadata filters, and recall testing steps.

output_examples.input: Search latency is rising as our collection grows.
output_examples.output: A tuning checklist for index parameters, caching, filtering strategy, batching, monitoring, and reindexing cadence.

best_practices: Define recall, latency, freshness, and cost goals before choosing a database.
Test chunking and embedding choices with representative queries and judged results.
Monitor drift, failed retrievals, index growth, and rebuild requirements over time.
anti_patterns: Do not select a database only because it is popular.
Do not tune index parameters without a measured evaluation set.
Do not store sensitive metadata without access controls and retention rules.

faq.question: What databases does this skill cover?
faq.answer: It covers Pinecone, Weaviate, Qdrant, Milvus, and pgvector at an architectural guidance level.

faq.question: Can it help with RAG systems?
faq.answer: Yes. It focuses on retrieval design, chunking, embeddings, filters, and search quality for RAG workflows.

faq.question: Does it write production code?
faq.answer: It can guide implementation plans, but the skill itself is a Markdown instruction file, not an executable package.

faq.question: Can it improve search accuracy?
faq.answer: It can recommend evaluation methods, hybrid search, metadata filtering, and tuning steps to improve retrieval quality.

faq.question: Is it tied to one cloud provider?
faq.answer: No. It discusses managed services, open source databases, and Postgres based vector storage options.

faq.question: What inputs should I provide?
faq.answer: Provide data size, query examples, update frequency, latency targets, filters, hosting constraints, and cost limits.
